lines.text: Many learners say: He is married with Anna.
Better: He is married to Anna.
We say married to a person.
To! He is married to Anna!

data.why: We say married to a person.

native.tip: « Marié avec » se traduit mot à mot, mais en anglais on dit “married to”.
native.caption: Vous dites “He is married with Anna.” ? Après “married”, la préposition est “to”, pas “with”. Dites plutôt “He is married to Anna.” — écoutez Carlos et répétez avec lui ! Plus d’exercices dans l’appli Lexkite.
native.comment: Réponse : “He is married to Anna.” — Après “married”, la préposition est “to”, pas “with”. Testez d’autres pièges avec un quiz gratuit : {link}

en.tip: Learners often say “married with”. English says “married to” a person.
en.caption: Do you say this? “He is married with Anna.” After “married”, the word is “to”, not “with”. Say “He is married to Anna.” Listen to Carlos and repeat with him! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
